subject: Error in model transfer to past time

messages.author: 102c49f4f5bd3d38
messages.subject: Error in model transfer to past time
parts:
Hi everyone,
I'm using Wallace to model the current and past distribution of a species and everything works well until I try to use the model transfer module. I keep getting this error that I haven't selected a time period even though I did, see screenshots below. Does anyone know what is happening here? thank you!!

messages.author: 881c0dd9c7b0d196
messages.subject: Re: Error in model transfer to past time
parts:
Thanks for writing in. I can take a look and make sure the ecoClimate module is still working.
In the meantime, you can try using the "Draw polygon" tool (instead of "Same Extent") and use the polygon drawing tool and draw a shape near where you want to project, or try drawing one elsewhere as a means to reset it. I would also suggest try using either another GCM or RCP, just to see if it is working. If it does work, you can use the red reset button and try again. You can always run something else, download your session code within the Reproduce component, and then edit the session code to run the analyses you are actually trying to perform. 
Let me know if these alternates work, it might be a glitch in a specific ecoClimate file for that extent, time period, or GCM.

messages.subject: Re: Error in model transfer to past time
parts:
Thanks for your reply. I tried other settings like using a different polygon for the extent and also using MIROC and other GCM and it still did not work. I did try downloading the layers in R and it works! so I don't think it is an issue with EcoClimate, I wonder if I am specifying correctly the layers? Am I supposed to go back to the "Env Data" step and download the layers for the other time periods there, or does Wallace download them through the "Transfer" module?

Also, I did try performing the model transfer in R and I am not sure whether it works because I have not been able to plot the output. Is there a different function that I should try for plotting? Alternatively, I also tried using the same code Wallace uses to visualize the model prediction but that also did not work for the time transfer model.

This is the code I am running for model transfer after using the code that I downloaded from Wallace to do the ENMs for the present:

# Time period: Holocene #

## extent to transfer
selCoords <- matrix(c(-123.573532, -104.852829, -101.425095, -94.481735, -83.055954, -73.475876, -68.114548, -79.804001, -95.800095, -98.964157, -106.34697, -123.573532, 38.855216, 41.671373, 47.841275, 47.723159, 43.483318, 46.888824, 42.648607, 31.389399, 27.330905, 21.000548, 18.26913, 38.855216),ncol=2,byrow=FALSE)  # This is the same polygon I used in the model for the "current" time.
polyExt <- sp::SpatialPolygons(list(sp::Polygons(list(sp::Polygon(selCoords)),
                                                 ID = 1)))

# load model
model_current <- model_Tr  # this is the model I got from running Maxnet for the "current" time

# Transfer model
occsEnvs <- model_current@occs
bgEnvs <- model_current@bg
envsFut <- envs_ecoClimate(
  bcAOGCM = "CCSM",
  bcScenario = "Holo",
  ecoClimSel = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17))
envsFut <- raster::stack(envsFut)
modXfer <- xfer_time(evalOut = model_current, curModel = 'fc.H_rm.0.5',
                     envs = envsFut, alg = 'maxnet',
                     xfExt = polyExt, clamp = TRUE, outputType = 'cloglog')

# plot model transfer
raster::plot(modXfer)

#
This is the error that I get after trying to plot this model:
Error in xy.coords(x, y, xlabel, ylabel, log) :
  'x' is a list, but does not have components 'x' and 'y'

messages.subject: Re: Error in model transfer to past time
parts:
Hi Stephania,

I think I fixed the problem. You can uninstall your current version of Wallace and re-install this branch from GitHub, and test to make sure the problem is fixed for you. Hopefully the issue is corrected and I can move forward on updating the CRAN version of Wallace.

install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("bjohnso005/wallace@xfer_dev")
library(wallace)
run_wallace()

Bethany
